title: Taken over in place
subtitle: This run does not copy data. Tugra starts next to Coolify on the same machine, checks every site, then takes the ports.
badgeHint: Same machine, no data copy: Coolify stays on the server until you remove it, and giving it back is one click.
none: The takeover has not been planned yet. It is read from the server when the test step starts; nothing is changed before that.
unreadable: The takeover could not be read. Try again.
rollup: {apps} apps: {reused} reuse Coolify's image, {rebuilt} rebuilt with Tugra and verified, {rebuilding} still being built, {problems} with a problem, {declined} could not be rebuilt, {skipped} left out.
databases: {count} databases are taken over on their own data.

outcome.rebuilding: Rebuilding with Tugra, not verified yet
outcome.rebuilt_check_failed: Rebuilt with Tugra, but a domain does not answer like Coolify's copy
outcome.rebuild_failed: The rebuild with Tugra failed, so the app is left out
outcome.rebuild_declined: Rebuild asked for, but it shares data with Coolify's copy, so it reuses the image
outcome.database: Database, taken over on its own data

domains: {ok} of {total} domains answer like Coolify's copy

DEPLOY_DARK.planned: In place: the takeover is planned from what Coolify runs. Nothing was changed.
DEPLOY_DARK.tested: In place: Tugra's proxy runs with no public port and every site was checked on it.
DEPLOY_DARK.done: In place: the test beside Coolify passed.
DEPLOY_DARK.gaveBack: In place: Tugra stopped and Coolify serves the sites as before.
DEPLOY_DARK.failed: In place: the test did not finish. Coolify still serves the sites.

VERIFY.review: In place: review the test, then approve to take the ports.

CUTOVER.swapping: In place: handing the ports over. This takes a minute.
CUTOVER.swapped: In place: Tugra serves the sites. It is getting a new certificate for each domain.
CUTOVER.verified: In place: every site works and has a new certificate.
CUTOVER.gaveBack: In place: given back, Coolify serves the sites again.
CUTOVER.failed: In place: the switch did not finish and was put back.
